message: pnpm 12.16.1 loads hooks/pnpmfile.cjs, which pnpmfile names, and the updateConfig hook of a pnpmfile can change every setting after pnpm has read its configuration files, so depcurfew cannot verify the settings it checks
fix: Read hooks/pnpmfile.cjs and make sure its updateConfig hook leaves minimumReleaseAge, allowBuilds and the other security settings as they are, or take it out of pnpmfile in pnpm-workspace.yaml if the project does not need it

message: pnpm 12.16.1 loads the pnpmfile ~/.pnpm/global_pnpmfile.cjs, which globalPnpmfile in pnpm-workspace.yaml names and depcurfew cannot read, and the updateConfig hook of a pnpmfile can change every setting after pnpm has read its configuration files, so depcurfew cannot verify the settings it checks
fix: Read ~/.pnpm/global_pnpmfile.cjs and make sure its updateConfig hook leaves minimumReleaseAge, allowBuilds and the other security settings as they are, or take it out of globalPnpmfile in pnpm-workspace.yaml if the project does not need it
